name: optipress-monorepo
description: Production-grade privacy-first PDF and Image Optimizer monorepo foundation

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=packages/types && npm run build --workspace=packages/config

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run build:server
